Specific subject: Cereales rellenos de crema de cacao y avellana Hacendado sin gluten, Mercadona product id 9547. Match Image 1 exactly. No detached catalog badges.
Packaging guidance: Brown cereal BAG «Cacao & Avellana Avelã / SIN SEM GLUTEN», 400g. SIN SEM must be present.
